prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers. Keep values strictly greater than 13; add twice each kept value; print the result.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]>13) { total+=2*values[i]. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).
